Asic sprites macros (C)

Useful Asic sprites related macros designed to be used in your C programs

Macros
cpctm_getSpriteDataPtr

Get pointer to sprite hardware definition

C Definition

#define cpctm_getSpriteDataPtr (SPR)

ASM Call

For asm programs, please refer to <cpct_asicSetSpriteData_asm>

Parameters
SPR

Hardware sprite identifier (0..15)

Known limitations:

  • This macro will produce no-code when used with constant values. If any of the given values is a variable, it will procuce calculation code. This code will be translated by C-compiler into ASM, and may be slow.
